commits.message:
refactor: replace boolean isCropped with ImageSourceType enum, fix imports

- Add ImageSourceType enum (CROPPED / FULL_PAGE)
- AiService: extractDishesFromImages / buildFromImage use ImageSourceType
- LunchService: pass ImageSourceType.CROPPED / FULL_PAGE explicitly
- ContentService: add URI and URISyntaxException imports, remove FQCNs

commits.author: copilot-swe-agent[bot]
commits.message:
fix: clamp crop coordinates, add PROMPT_PDF for full-page images

- ContentService: clamp x/y to image bounds before getSubimage()
- AiService: add PROMPT_PDF for PDF type (full-page, no 'Ausschnitt' wording)
- AiService: extractDishesFromImages gains isCropped flag to select correct prompt
- LunchService: IMAGE type passes isCropped=true, PDF type passes isCropped=false

commits.author: copilot-swe-agent[bot]
commits.message:
fix: use precise MIME-type detection, narrow catch clauses in AiService

- ContentService: parse URL via URI to extract path extension instead of substring search
- AiService: catch JsonProcessingException instead of generic Exception in extractCropBox
- AiService: catch InvalidMimeTypeException and IllegalArgumentException instead of generic Exception in resolveMimeTypeFromValue

commits.author: copilot-swe-agent[bot]
commits.message:
feat: upgrade model to gpt-5.6-luna, split image/text prompts, add image crop pre-step

- Update AI model in application.yml from gpt-5-nano to gpt-5.6-luna
- Add CropBox record (percentage-based crop coordinates)
- Add PROMPT_IMAGE (new image-specific prompt, split from PROMPT_TEXT)
- Add PROMPT_CROP (minimal crop-analysis prompt)
- Add AiService.extractCropBox() for two-step image cropping
- Add ContentService.downloadImageAsDataUri() and cropDataUri()
- Update LunchService IMAGE type: download → crop analysis → crop → extract
